title.narrative: Increased quality of labour standards and protection through Labour Law implementation (DWCP Outcome 2.1)

description.narrative: This intervention aims to strengthen labour standards and enhance worker protection in Lao PDR through effective implementation of the Labour Law, with a particular focus on occupational safety and health (OSH) as a Fundamental Principle and Right at Work. Despite existing legal provisions, many workplaces continue to face challenges such as unsafe working conditions, limited awareness of OSH obligations, and weak systems for recording and reporting occupational accidents and diseases. In collaboration with partner organizations, including the World Health Organization, the initiative develops and implements a national OSH programme and strengthens institutional and workplace-level capacities. Key components include the enhancement of the legal and policy frameworks, establishment of a national system for recording and notifying occupational accidents and diseases, capacity building of the tripartite partners for improved compliance, towards the promotion of safety and health preventative culture and continuous improvement of national OSH system. By taking integrated approach, this initiative contributes to the realization and promotion of Fundamental Principles and Rights at Work with particular focus on a safe and healthy working environment for all workers in Lao PDR, including women and migrant workers. This supports the broader goals of decent work, sustainable development, and social justice under the Lao PDR Decent Work Country Programme.
